Azerbaijani Special Warfare Naval Units 2012 / Azərbaycan Sahil Mühafizəsi Dəstəsi 2012
recentItems.description:
Azerbaijani 641st Special Warfare Naval Units. The training and organisation structure of the unit may be similar to Turkish special forces, Su Altı Taarruz and United States Special Forces who have a training relationship with them.

This video shows recent naval trainings in Caspian sea, where 1200 military units, 21 navy ships, 20 boats and 8 helicopters participated. Semper Fi to Azerbaijan.
